title: KAITO — At The Mercy Of The Mysterious〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

meta.Card: At The Mercy Of The Mysterious（4★）

rows.Line: Between Worlds

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: This place is overflowing with feelings again today.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: (These little sparks of emotion may also one day develop into their own...)
KAITO!!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Huh?!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Oh, Rin, Len, it's you two.
You startled me, calling out like that...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: It's your fault for spacing out.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Yeah! Anyone would want to pull a little prank after finding a person spacing out, right?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: I wouldn't say I was spacing out, exactly...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Anyway, are you two off to see how the other SEKAI are doing?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
No, we already did that!
I went over to see band me and theater me!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: I just got back from watching idol me do a concert.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Hehe. From your expressions, I assume everyone's doing well.

rows.Speaker: Len & Rin
rows.Line: Yup!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Oh, KAITO, that reminds me!
Remember what we talked about with Luka the other day?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Ah, about Lens from certain SEKAI swapping places with other Lens?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Yeah, that!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Len was just telling me about it too!
It sounded really fun, so I'd love to think about what would happen for me, too!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: You should join us too!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Hmm... Well...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Hehe. I guess my hands are tied.
If you insist, then I'll just have to join you.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Awesome! Thanks!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Let's start by thinking about what would happen if one SEKAI's KAITO got swapped with another SEKAI's KAITO!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Wait, me? Don't you want to start, Rin?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: No, I wanna hear a good example of how this works first!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
In that case...
Hmm...  Let's think about band me, shall we?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: If he switched places with DJ me, then I feel that he'd fit right into that SEKAI.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Yeah! He can play music, so I'm guessing...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Hey, KAITO! Can you play something for us again today?!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Something that'll pump us up!
A song that gets us excited about practicing!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Oh, if you're taking requests, then I'd like to make one next♪

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Can MEIKO and I go after that?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Sure...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: ...Is what would happen. He'd be super popular!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Okay, so that's how you do this!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Lemme see... Hmm...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Oh, imagine if he were switched with idol KAITO instead! That could spell trouble!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Yes... Band me isn't much of a talker, so he might find the idol versions of Luka and MEIKO overwhelming.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Based on that logic, being swapped with theater KAITO might also be bad, right?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: That version of me is the troupe leader everybody counts on, so filling those shoes could prove challenging.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: The ones who could do it well are probably idol me and...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
DJ KAITO, right?
I feel like he'd become friends with everyone and start contributing right away!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Y-Yes...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
(But nobody would be able to stop him.
I'm actually a little scared since he'd be free to do whatever he wanted.)

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Let's see... Who's left?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: The KAITO from Mafuyu's SEKAI, right?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Ah, that me...
Hmm... I have the hardest time picturing anything about him.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Really? I actually think that he'd get along pretty well with everyone from that street SEKAI.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: I can kinda picture that MEIKO and Miku respecting his boundaries pretty well. And don't you think he'd manage to get along with their Luka too?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: The “us” over there would also probably think that version of you is really cool, KAITO! They might even want to copy him!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: R-Really...?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Aside from that... I think theater Rin and Len would probably find that KAITO scary at first.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Nah, I bet they'd like him a ton! He's still KAITO, after all!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Hehe. That'd be nice.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Thanks for chatting with me, you two!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: I had a lot of fun thinking about us from those other SEKAI!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: You're welcome!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: I'd like to thank you two as well. It was nice to hear from you both about how you see me in other SEKAI.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Things would get even more interesting if we could see if we were right or not.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Right? You mean how they'd all really react to being switched?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: It does sound interesting... But it would be terrible if it actually did happen.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Our SEKAI counterparts are all responsible for providing support to the ones who made their SEKAI. Not being where they need to be wouldn't be good...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Right.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: But all this talk is making me want to see them now...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Oh, I was just thinking the same thing!
Why don't the three of us go see them together sometime soon?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: I'm in! Are you, KAITO?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Of course. Let's all go together.

rows.Speaker: Rin & Len
rows.Line: Woohoo!
